stem: In the figure, line \(\ell\) is parallel to line \(m\). What is the value of \(y\)?
solution: The angles labeled \((7x - 22)^{\circ}\) and \((4x + 35)^{\circ}\) lie outside the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal, so they are alternate exterior angles and are equal.
\(7x - 22 = 4x + 35\), so \(3x = 57\) and \(x = 19\). Each of these angles measures \(4(19) + 35 = 111^{\circ}\).
The angle labeled \(y^{\circ}\) forms a straight line with the \(111^{\circ}\) angle at \(Q\), so \(y = 180 - 111 = 69\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['C'][1]==P['D'][1] and P['E'][1]==P['F'][1]
x=symbols('x')
xs=solve(Eq(7*x-22,4*x+35),x)[0]
assert abs(ang('C','P','S')-(7*xs-22))<0.1 and abs(ang('F','Q','T')-(4*xs+35))<0.1
ans=180-(4*xs+35)
assert abs(ang('F','Q','P')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==69
